summary: Independent backend-only verification of SubscriptionGateMiddleware. Ran full pytest suite (69/69 passing, incl. the 10 new tests/test_subscription_gate.py). Added tests/test_subscription_gate_live_http.py (26 tests) hitting the running uvicorn on 127.0.0.1:8765 to catch middleware-ordering / real-ASGI regressions the in-process suite could mask. Final result: 95/95 passing. Every claim in the spec verified: (a) 5 subscription rules honored (active, trialing-active, trialing-expired, past_due, canceled) — with details.subscription_status and details.trial_ends_at matching spec; (b) allowlist honored for /api/auth/*, /api/billing/* (incl. webhook), /api/health, /api/openapi.json, /api/docs; (c) webhook NEVER returns 402 (invalid signature -> 400, missing signature -> 400, blocked-clinic Bearer + bad signature -> 400); (d) anonymous / malformed / expired-signature tokens -> 401 (never 402); (e) Demo seed users (trial_ends_at NULL) NOT blocked; (f) 7 different business routes verified blocked (patients, agenda/appointments, finance/quotes, procedures, specialties, clinic-features, clinics/me).
critical_code_review_comments: src/core/subscription_middleware.py: implementation is clean and correct. Uses AsyncSessionLocal (no ContextVar), returns JSONResponse (no HTTPException), decodes JWT defensively (TokenError/KeyError/ValueError -> pass to route for 401), and correctly skips non-/api paths.
trial_ends_at NULL -> not blocked is documented in code (line 61-62) and confirmed live for the seed 'Demo Odonto' clinic (all 3 seed roles accessed /api/patients and /api/procedures with 200).

Middleware ordering in main.py is correct: SubscriptionGateMiddleware is added BEFORE RequestContextMiddleware, which under Starlette LIFO means Context runs first (outer) and Gate runs inside — so the DB session in Gate has request context available if needed.

Allowlist prefix matching uses str.startswith, so /api/billing/webhook is safely covered by '/api/billing'. Verified live: webhook returns 400 invalid_signature even when the request carries a Bearer token of a canceled clinic — critical for Stripe retries.

Error envelope matches spec exactly: {'error': {'code': 'subscription_inactive', 'message': 'Sua assinatura...', 'details': {'subscription_status': str, 'trial_ends_at': ISO8601Z|null}}}. trial_ends_at is serialized with a 'Z' suffix (UTC), consistent with the rest of the API.
No stripe_customer_id / stripe_subscription_id leaks: verified in /api/billing/status body for a past_due clinic.

Full suite = 95 tests, all green. Uvicorn runs manually on 127.0.0.1:8765 (no supervisor, no --reload). Postgres: postgresql://dental:dental@localhost:5432/dental_crm (SUPERUSER). Signup schema: clinic_legal_name / clinic_trade_name / clinic_cnpj / admin_full_name / admin_email / admin_password / plan (returns access_token + clinic.id at 201). Business routes discovered from /api/openapi.json — the ones with GET-no-required-params suitable for gate testing: /api/patients, /api/finance/quotes, /api/procedures, /api/specialties, /api/clinic-features, /api/clinics/me. /api/agenda/appointments needs start&end query params (a 422 there still proves gate passed). Webhook endpoint: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET is 'whsec_PLACEHOLDER' (truthy), so bad signature -> 400 invalid_signature (NOT 503). The test_subscription_gate_live_http suite depends on psycopg2 (already installed).
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found. Spec-to-implementation mapping is 100%. The only test transient during my run was on my new test where I asserted /api/agenda/appointments would return 200 without required query params; corrected to accept 200 or 422 (both prove the gate did not block), which is the semantically correct assertion for a gate test anyway.
